answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the pulse of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the hollow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. What survives to the glacier is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
